method: Read source bytes and frozen JSON/text only; line-anchored source reasoning. No owner module imported or executed, no live kernel or target filesystem observations, no network.
recommendation_scope: Historical evidence supports raw namespace preservation and full stat-mode observation. It does not independently freeze exact mount, root, aggregate namespace, start, process/group or descriptor incarnation projections. The normative contract is a separate artifact.

Frozen syscall denial list includes unshare,setns,mount,umount2 and other privileged mechanisms; source evidence supports conditional containment constraints.

Owned attachment authentication checks retained original and current issuing process. This capability authentication must remain distinct from a nonsecret kernel projection.

findings.conclusion: Raw readlink text and raw cgroup text comparison are historical conventions. Individual namespace raw preservation is supported; source does not validate a canonical decimal grammar or establish an inode digit maximum.

A new strict lowercase ASCII kind:[canonical decimal] grammar can preserve the conventional observation directly, with no whitespace/normalization alias. Treat this as an explicit new serialization choice, not a historical validator. No finite semantic inode width is pinned by the reviewed sources.

Historical open(...).read() preserves text without explicit trim but is text-mode I/O; it is not proof of a newly frozen exact-byte preimage. Namespace cgroup inode and cgroup membership text are distinct facts.

Freeze full int(st_mode) consistently for observed entry/root metadata, because observation checks file kind and metadata. Permissions-only S_IMODE is source-supported for restoration only. Do not accept both encodings or infer an unpinned narrow maximum.

Mount ID or device/inode equality alone does not prove incarnation continuity. Bind projection to authenticated actual namespace/container/workspace/controller generation and coherent original mount/root relation. Existing containment permits future conditional continuity reasoning but does not provide its implemented observer. No new held descriptor, hidden counter or lifetime mechanism is established by this audit.

PID/TID/PGID alone is insufficient. Distinguish whole incarnation projection from starttime component and bind PID namespace plus outer generation. Historical source does not already serialize process/task starttime. Child new-session precedent supports group leader binding only.

Distinct aggregate role requires an explicit purposeful canonical seven-observation tuple/digest preimage or remains underspecified. Concatenation or duplicate alias is not supplied by historical source.

Use disjoint actual-fd and potential-relation tags only after each relation is defined. A numeric fd slot must be bound to writer incarnation and current coherent observation; it does not identify a durable open-file-description incarnation. Potential access is an interpreted relation, not a kernel fd. If defining that relation requires deciding forbidden potential-access semantics, keep this scalar unresolved.

Accepted integer width is at most 19 digits by the existing schema, accepted ID UTF-8 width is at most 256, and subordinate_mount_count serializes as 0. Neither acceptance cap proves all valid kernel facts have finite semantic widths within it; unrepresentable data must fail closed without truncation or budget-only hashing.

Reviewed source text contains no mountinfo, fdinfo or process/task stat-starttime observer. Capability-owner issuing PID checks and source hashes must not be relabeled as kernel incarnation identities.
